feeds.title: Indie Herbalist
feeds.description: Indie Herbalist is a lifestyle blog dedicated to living and loving the life botanic through the practical magic of herbalism. At Indie Herbalist, we celebrate the life botanic with gardening tips and tricks, herbal recipes to spice up the kitchen, and tutorials and DIY projects for the home herbalist.

feeds.title: Growing In The Garden » Herb
feeds.description: Angela Judd is an organic gardener in Arizona sharing Herb garden inspiration, ideas & helpful tips for growing your own garden.

feeds.title: The Herb Society of America » Gardening
feeds.description: Featuring articles that have to do exclusively with Herb gardening. The Herb Society of America is a nonprofit, educational organization dedicated to promoting the knowledge, use, and delight of herbs.

feeds.title: Buchanan's Native Plants Blog
feeds.description: Buchanan's Native Plants is Houston's largest and the Heights' favorite garden center devoted to Texas native plants and organic gardening. Here you will find the best selections of hardy natives as well as perennials, herbs, vegetables, trees, shrubs & roses, all suited to the Houston climate. Follow this blog that provides valuable tips, suggestions, and a forum to share ideas about getting the most from your garden.

feeds.title: Kellogg Garden » Herb Gardening
feeds.description: Blog posts cover herb gardening plans, tips, and ideas. Kellogg garden helps people create beautiful landscapes and gardens with high-quality organic soils, amendments & fertilizers.

feeds.title: Urban Leaf » Herbs
feeds.description: Curated lists and articles to learn how to care for your new or existing herb gardens. Urban Leaf helps urbanites and small-space gardeners grow their own food.

feeds.title: The Herb Exchange
feeds.description: Provides useful tips on growing herbs, DIY Gardening, Culinary Herbs, and companion planting. The Herb Exchange specializes in culinary, medicinal, aromatic, and rare herbs and grows farm-fresh, natural, non-GMO herb plants.

feeds.title: herbalblessingsblog
feeds.description: Blog by Carolee Snyder about growing and harvesting a bounty of blessings in the potager. As a professional herb and lavender grower, she often writes articles on seasonal gardening, growing vegetables & herbs, and flower farm.
